answerBlock.what: Integrated Mixer Pump is an electric integrated concrete mixer pump manufactured by Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Catalogue parameters: main motor 45 kW plus mixer 14 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, 100 m / 300 m, hopper 0.4 m³, max aggregate 4 cm and below, delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm, 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm, 4500 kg. Series note: 30 series with 400 mixer; 40/50 series with 500 mixer. It is not a mixing plant and not a boom pump.

faqs.question: Is a mixer pump the same as a mixing plant?
faqs.answer: No. A mixer pump mixes and pumps on one Xingtai trailer. Pinjin does not list a concrete batching plant on this catalogue.

faqs.question: Is the electric mixer pump the same as Electric 40?
faqs.answer: No. Electric 40 is a pump-only trailer: 45 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, fine-stone 120 m / 360 m, 2300 kg. This mixer pump adds a 14 kW mixer motor, lists 100 m / 300 m, pipe 100 / 125 mm and 4500 kg.
